source_documents.notes: Email from Kenneth M. Daniel (DMA NGVA-FMO-AE) to Mike Smith (BFA), dated May 5 2022, transmitting the RFP and describing commander's intent for pathogen-adaptive HVAC capabilities.
Request for Fee Proposal for Emporia RC HVAC Upgrades, State PN 123-18578-020 / VAFM PN 22-0023. Dated May 5, 2022. Contains full scope of services, construction requirements, timeline.

Historical reference drawings attached to the RFP package. Contents: (1-2) Emporia Airport property survey plats (1976); (3) Emporia Armory as-built site survey (1993, Rouse & Associates); (4) CO2 suppression system drawing for Emporia Armory, 410 Courtland Road; (5) Pre-engineered metal storage building elevations (DMA/Facilities Eng & Mgmt, Emporia VA); (6-7) Small arms storage vault drawings (Kenneth P. Werner, Architect); (8) Vehicle marshaling area diagram. All are existing-building reference documents, not design deliverables for this project.

Referenced as 'Exhibit D - Ref2 - Drawing 1 HVAC Design Bldg 9-4'. PDF is corrupt/unreadable — both pdftotext and pdftoppm failed with xref table errors. Content cannot be extracted. Likely a reference HVAC drawing for Building 9-4. Requires human review or re-export from source.

sheets.title: Plat Showing Survey and Division of Emporia Airport Property
sheets.reading_notes: Historic survey plat (1976) of Emporia Airport property in Greensville County and Southampton County, Virginia. Drawn by Richard A. Bristow, C.L.S. Scale 1"=500'. Shows runway area, parcels, and area summary table (total ~392 acres). Reference document only — not related to readiness center building HVAC scope. Appears to be background context on the armory property history.

sheets.title: Plat Showing Survey and Division of Emporia Airport Property (Exhibit A stamp)
sheets.reading_notes: Duplicate or alternate version of airport property plat. Stamped 'EXHIBIT A' and 'ADAP PROJECT No. 5-51-0013-01, 9/24/76'. Same content as page 1. Reference document only.

sheets.title: Emporia Armory As-Built Drawing — Site Survey
sheets.reading_notes: As-built site survey by Rouse & Associates, P.C. (Civil Engineers, Surveyors, Planners), Chesapeake, VA, dated March 15, 1993. Prepared for Hudgins Construction. Shows existing armory campus: prominent '1-STORY BRICK BUILDING' at center, 'METAL BLDG.' (pre-engineered), 'BLOCK BLDG.' noted. Scale 1"=30'. Finished floor elevation 124.66'. This is the existing readiness center building — confirms 1-story construction. No dimension annotations visible for building footprint area.

sheets.title: Emporia Armory CO2 Suppression System — Floor Plan and Piping Isometric
sheets.reading_notes: Drawing by FTI-X Corporation for Emporia Armory, 410 Courtland Road, Emporia, Virginia. CO2 suppression system design — floor plan (scale 1/4"=1'-0") and piping isometric (no scale). Shows carbon dioxide hazard calculations and system specifications in legend. Confirms facility address: 410 Courtland Road, Emporia, VA. Discipline: fire protection. Drawing is a reference/as-built for an existing suppression system; not HVAC design work. Sheet is heavily annotated but text is small and partially legible.

sheets.title: Pre-Engineered Metal Storage Building — Elevations (DMA, Emporia VA)
sheets.reading_notes: DMA Facilities Engineering and Management, Commonwealth of Virginia drawing dated 12 Feb 1993. Shows North, South, East, and West elevations of a pre-engineered metal storage building at Emporia, VA. Finished floor elevation 124.66'. Sheet A-1 of 1. Single-story metal building on the armory campus (matches 'METAL BLDG.' on as-built survey). Vertical metal siding with louvers, minimal windows, bay door opening on north elevation. This is likely the vehicle storage/maintenance building associated with the armory.

sheets.title: Small Arms Storage Vault — Vault Plan, Sections, and Vault Door Details
sheets.reading_notes: By Kenneth P. Werner, AIA Architect, 3401 Brook Road (Richmond, VA 23220). Title: 'Small Arms Storage Vault — USP&O Warehouse, Waller Depot, Richmond, VA'. Sheet 1 of 1. Shows vault plan, sections A-A, B-B, C-C, D-D, E-E, vault door section, plan of vault door. Approved by Army Installation Division / National Guard Bureau. Unclear why this drawing is included — it references Waller Depot in Richmond, not the Emporia armory. Likely an inadvertent attachment included in the historical file for reference on vault construction details.

sheets.title: Small Arms Storage Vault — Vault Plan, Sections, and Vault Door Details (duplicate)
sheets.reading_notes: Appears to be a duplicate or second copy of ATTACH-06 (same Kenneth P. Werner vault drawing). Identical content. Possibly a different revision or reproduction copy.

sheets.title: Vehicle Marshaling Area Diagram
sheets.reading_notes: Schematic site diagram showing a Vehicle Marshaling Area. Dimensions: 1680' long access lane, 200' wide, with 435' and 50' and 680' sub-dimensions for parking/staging areas. Shows 'Air & Rail Ops Bldg (See Detail)'. High mast lighting noted. Seal visible (appears to be Army Corps / USACE-related). This may be a DMA facility expansion concept or reference for another related facility — not directly related to the Emporia Readiness Center HVAC scope.
